metadata.name: MASITINIB
metadata.description: Using the trade name Masivet, this compound has been used for several years to treat mast cell tumours in dogs [6]. It is a receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK) inhibitor, with inhibitory activity at the cKIT, platelet derived growth factor receptor (PDGFR) and fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR) RTKs.
